courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 浮動式道床減振
related.transfer: 可遷移「墊片壓縮剛度」與「絕緣電阻量級」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；浮動式道床減振的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Pad compression stiffness" and "Insulation resistance scale" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Floating-slab track vibration isolation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦扣件預壓彈性絕緣與疲勞的共同設計；浮動式道床減振則以浮動道床隔振共振及附加質量效應為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on fastener preload resilience insulation and fatigue design; Floating-slab track vibration isolation centres on floating-slab isolation resonance and added-mass effects, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「墊片壓縮剛度」與「隔振固有頻率」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到浮動式道床減振，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「剛度不均分力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Pad compression stiffness” and “Isolation natural frequency”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Floating-slab track vibration isolation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Unequal-stiffness force share", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 鐵路路基過渡段處理
related.transfer: 可遷移「墊片壓縮剛度」與「絕緣電阻量級」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路路基過渡段處理的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Pad compression stiffness" and "Insulation resistance scale" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Railway subgrade transition treatment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦扣件預壓彈性絕緣與疲勞的共同設計；鐵路路基過渡段處理則以剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on fastener preload resilience insulation and fatigue design; Railway subgrade transition treatment centres on stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「墊片壓縮剛度」與「相鄰支承位移差」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路路基過渡段處理，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「支承能量比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Pad compression stiffness” and “Adjacent-support displacement difference”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Railway subgrade transition treatment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Support strain-energy comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軌道扣件彈性設計
history.text: 本課把軌道扣件彈性設計放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。扣件同時控制鋼軌位置、提供彈性支承與維持電氣條件，增加夾持力並不保證所有性能改善；墊片、彈條與錨定件的路徑需分開辨認。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Resilient rail-fastening design in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Fastenings locate the rail, provide resilient support and maintain electrical conditions; increasing clamping force does not improve every property, so pads, clips and anchors need separate load-path interpretation. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「墊片壓縮剛度」到「剛度劣化比例」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Pad compression stiffness" through "Stiffness degradation fraction" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
